caseName: Minneapolis, St. Paul & Sault Ste. Marie Railway Co. v. Leora ex rel. Leora
caseNameFull: Minneapolis, St. Paul & Sault Ste. Marie Railway Co., in Error v. Joseph Leora, by John Leora, his Guardian ad litem
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of Wisconsin.
attorneys: Mr. Wm. A. Hayes and Mr. L. K. Luse for the plaintiff in error. Mr. Walter L._Gold and Mr. W. P. Crawford for the defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of .jurisdiction upon the authority of Spies v. Illinois, 123 U. S. 131, 181; Erie R. R. v. Purdy, 185 U. S. 148, 154; Louisville & N. R. R. v. Woodford, 234 U. S. 46; Willoughby v. Chicago, ante, p. 45 (decided this term). (See Chicago, Milwaukee & St. Paul Ry. v. Hanson, ante, p. 693, decided this term.)
